0022600207.text: The Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home) host the Indiana Pacers (3-7, 0-5 at home) with Dallas sitting 10th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest, while Indiana is 11th in the East and 4 games back in the Central. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring, strain), with T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Mavericks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 121-105 win in Indianapolis on October 23, and they also won 2-0 in the 2025-26 series.
